nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group lets you remove, composite, crop, and outpaint the background.
🔹 Select 'true' to replace (🧭), which enables remove (👤) and composite (🍔).
🔹 Select 'false to reframe (🖼️), which enables crop (✂️) and outpaint (🚧).
🔹 When compositing (🍔), select 'true' to generate (🌳) or 'false' to load (📤) an image.
🔹 When outpainting (🚧), the image edges are extended to add latent data for sampling.
🔹 An inpainting model (1️⃣) is recommended for outpainting (🚧).
